why_it_trends: Proven 'spent X MINUTES renovating' format nobody has clipped for Kai; everyone has a friend who tunes settings for ages, so it's tag-a-friend bait, and comments argue about their own HDR settings.

honest_score.notes: Best concept; menus readable in the band, 'NO NO NO NO' paper-white payoff and 'my run needs to be X' closer land. Face is upscaled about 4x from a small cam (head ~345 px, soft). Kai is deadpan more than explosive.
